newsitem.title: CHINA: Oversea-Chinese bank opens China branch.
newsitem.headline: Oversea-Chinese bank opens China branch.

text.p: The Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp of Singapore has set up its fourth Chinese branch in Chengdu, capital of southwestern Sichuan province, a bank official said on Monday.
"We started trial business today," branch manager Huang Baishun said by telephone from Chengdu.
The branch had registered capital of 100 million yuan ($12 million) and had been approved by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, Huang said.
The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) had given approval for it to conduct foreign exchange business, including accepting savings, making loans and processing remittances, he said.
Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp already had branches in Shanghai, the northern port city of Tianjin and in Xiamen in southeastern Fujian province.
